column3: This app: the startup screen, the native runtime port and the Vulkan renderer. Copyright, no warranty, where the source is and what it is built on: the notice below.
By ImL1s (aa22396584). The Vulkan renderer and the GPU driver loader started as a copy of its code (2026-10-20) and have been changed since.
By sydeEvans. The Android port of d2r-mobile that the D2R Android port imported; part of the renderer descends from it.
The native runtime the port is built on: loader, Horizon services, audio and the game's patches.
From jhaizhou's d2r-mobile, by way of MacNativeGames: the NVN graphics layer and texture conversion.
By h1k421: the declarations of the Switch graphics API that the graphics layer implements.
Decoding block-compressed textures.
Code in the runtime derived from AMD FidelityFX, nxnative and Ryujinx's audio renderer.
Translates the game's shaders for Vulkan (libtotk_xlate.so).
By Valiantsin Dzerakh, its per-object motion vectors by DizzyMan1337: the shader translator's last-frame position and the object motion for frame generation and upscaling follow it.
The runtime compiled into the shader translator (NativeAOT).

column2: MIT; some parts Apache-2.0 or BSL-1.0
column3: The bundled Turnip Vulkan driver for Adreno GPUs (libvulkan_freedreno.so), with this project's fixes.
Loads the bundled or an installed GPU driver.
Part of libadrenotools' hooks: loads the driver outside Android's library namespaces.
The in-game menu.
Frame generation (the LSFG framegen library; the player's own Lossless Scaling shaders are not part of the app).
Vulkan function loading for frame generation.
Translates the shaders of the player's own Lossless.dll for Vulkan, on the device (libtotklsfg.so). Taken out of DXVK by the dxbc project.
By The Khronos Group: spirv.hpp and GLSL.std.450.h, part of the DXBC compiler. Both carry this licence.
Reads the resources of the player's own Lossless.dll (libtotklsfg.so).
The FSR 1 upscaler and sharpening.
The FSR 3.1 frame generation: frame interpolation and optical flow.
Temporal upscaling (Arm ASR).
Anti-aliasing.
By Nguyen Anh Quynh: decodes the game's code in the code rewriter (port/android/setup/patcher). Listed once libtokpatcher.a is built into the APK.
The frame capture hook for debugging (the header's licence).
Audio decoding.
Video playback for the game's cutscenes.
Decompression of the game's files and the mod installer.
The C++ standard library, linked into the native libraries by the Android NDK.
The startup screen's text font.
The startup screen's title font.

By Adobe. In the place of the console's shared fonts, cut down to the characters the game takes from them: accented letters, punctuation, signs and kana in the Chinese and Korean text. The Bold's letters also mark the L and R keys of the PlayStation button icons.
